SELECT X.BUYER AS BUYER , DECODE(SUBSTR(X.BUYER,7,1) ,'G',(SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = X.BUYER) , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = X.BUYER) ) AS BUYER_NAME , X.CNT FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER AS BUYER , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KEP_S_STOCK A /* 구매대행재고수불 */ , ICOMCQDT B /* 구매사별 계약서 가격정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND B.AGENT = #{agent} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.SELLER = B.AGENT AND B.S_STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY A.BUYER ) X
